question: Which of the following elements is NOT a component of baking soda?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Calcium.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Calcium is not a component of baking soda.
 
• **Sodium Bicarbonate** is the chemical name of **Baking Soda**.
 
• The other name for Sodium Bicarbonate is** Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate.** It is popularly called** cooking soda.**
 
• The chemical formula of **Baking Soda is NaHCO3.**
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is non flammable.
 
• Baking soda is basic in nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uses of Sodium bicarbonate **are following:-

 
 
• It acts as an antacid that is used to treat the stomach.
 
• It is used in fire extinguishers due to the formation of soapy foam.
 
• It acts as a pesticide.
 
• It neutralizes the effect of acid as a neutralizer.
 
• In the stomach, Reduces the acidity.
 
 
 
• Baking soda was first manufactured by** French chemist Nicolas Leblanc**.
 
• It was first manufactured in **1971.**
